resolution.note: inTestSlot: guard, tsc and related tests share one host-wide slot, wait printed; test/scripts/fast-slots.test.ts passes

title: Concurrent npm run fast across lanes has no host-wide test budget
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: three krn-lane subagents and the lead each ran npm run fast at once; load average reached 103 (uptime 15:07), one lane's fast ran over 15 minutes and reported BLOCKER, the lead's fast exceeded 600 s.
Outcome: npm run fast and the related-test runner take a host-wide slot (a lock-file semaphore under ~/.cache/krn or the main checkout .krn/tmp) sized to CPU count / test concurrency, so concurrent lanes queue instead of thrashing; the wait is printed.
Proof: node --test test/scripts/fast-slots.test.ts: pass (two concurrent fast runs with slots=1 run one after the other).
Files: scripts/fast-check.ts
